notes: Vals AI boards for Gemini 4 Argon, read 2026-10-13 (board metadata updated 2026-10-12 for 18 views). Argon is on all 18 views stored for Muse Wonder (Vals Index, Finance Agent v2, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and Science, Harvey HLAB, ProgramBench, SWE-bench Multimodal, BioMysteryBench, CyberBench v1.1, EMB, Code Migration, Legal Research, MysteryMechanism, ProofBench v1.1, Public Benefits v1.1, Tax Agent, Vibe Code v1.1, IOI) and on seven more Vals boards (MedCode, MedScribe, SAGE, SRE Bench, LegalBench, CUA-bench, Time Horizon Index: KSP). Rows are the 'overall' task read from the board view JSON each page loads (/_astro/benchmark_view_*.json); accuracy converted from percent to a 0-1 fraction; stderr, latency and cost per test as published (stderr is in the caveat). Argon ran at reasoning_effort high on every board (payload field). For the 18 Muse-lane views the rows reuse that file's source ids, snapshot ids and comparability groups; its 169 stored rows (peers and Muse models) were re-verified against the live view JSON (accuracy, cost, stderr, effort) and are unchanged, so peers are not repeated for those views. For the seven extra views the roster peers that have a row are stored (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1, Haiku 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra; Muse Wonder has none). Cost per test is Vals' figure; Vals shows Argon at $4/$20 per M. Rows are comparable:false with one comparability group per board. Argon had been recorded only in claims by the 2026-10-06 Vals files. Recheck on or after 2026-10-20.

claims.statement: Vals AI update note on the Argon model page (dated Sep 30, 2026), verbatim: 'Gemini 4 Argon places #1 of 41 on the Vals Index (68.90%) at $15.68 per test, ahead of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (67.04%, $21.34 per test), Claude Opus 5.5 (66.97%, $32.14) and Claude Fable 5.1 (65.83%, $28.71).' ... 'Gemini 4 Argon is priced at $4.00 per million input tokens and $20.00 per million output tokens. The model has a 1M-token context window and 262k max output tokens. Evaluations were run with reasoning effort set to "high" and temperature set to 1.0.' The page header and the Index board now show #1 of 47 (Vals added models after the note). Hyperparameters on the page: temperature 1, top-p and top-k default, max output tokens 262,144, reasoning effort high, default provider Google.
claims.implication: Vals prices Argon at the standard $4/$20, not the introductory $2/$10, and caps output at 262,144 tokens against Google's 1M long-decode limit; whether Vals' cost per test uses the standard or introductory price is not stated.

claims.statement: Vals Index, board updated 2026-10-12, 47 models (peer values equal the rows in vals-ai-muse-wonder-2026-10-13.json, re-verified for all 169 stored rows: accuracy, cost, stderr and effort): Gemini 4 Argon high 68.90% ($15.68/test, stderr 0.974 pp), Sonnet 5.5 67.04% ($21.34), Opus 5.5 66.97% ($32.14), Fable 5.1 65.83% ($28.71), Muse Wonder Full 64.57% ($8.56), GPT-6 Astra 63.13% ($18.46), GPT-6.1 Sol 61.15% ($3.24), Muse Wonder 61.06% ($11.43), Haiku 5.5 54.31% ($2.99). Argon's Vals Index, Finance Agent v2 (65.40%) and Terminal-Bench 4.0 (57.576%) values are unchanged from the 2026-10-06 files (vals-ai-index-finance-agent-2026-10-06.json, vals-ai-terminal-bench-4-2026-10-06.json), which kept Argon in claims only. The other 15 Argon rows here, and the seven extra boards, were not stored before.

CONFLICTS between Vals, AA and Google for the same benchmark name, stored side by side and not reconciled. Terminal-Bench 4.0: Vals (board harness Mini-SWE-agent) Argon 57.576% (stderr 2.314), Opus 5.5 65.15%, Sonnet 5.5 64.1%, Astra 59.6%; AA Intelligence Index Terminal-Bench 4.0 Argon 57.07%, Opus 5.5 59.60%; AA Coding Agents Terminal-Bench v4 (Antigravity CLI) Argon 56.06%. Harvey: Google's blog says Argon has 'similarly leading performance' on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark; Vals HLAB gives Argon 19.58% (stderr 3.31), 5th of 73 in Vals' update note and below Muse Wonder Full 21.67%, Muse Spark 1.3 23.8%; AA has no Argon value for Harvey LAB-AA. Finance Agent v2: Google says Argon leads; Vals Argon 65.40% is first of 78, ahead of Gemini 3.8 Flash 61.44%. IOI: Argon 100.00% ties GPT-6 Astra (Vals note).

Vals Argon rows not stored as score rows: Vals RSI Index 30.55% (rank 4 of 24, page lists it but the benchmark page carries no board view JSON that could be parsed) and the Vals model-page rank/stderr table, which duplicates the stored boards. Rows for these seven boards were added with Argon plus every roster model that has a row: MedCode 58.80% (Opus 5.5 49.80, Sonnet 5.5 52.92, Fable 5.1 53.51, Haiku 5.5 51.54, Sol 48.84, Astra 48.49), MedScribe 87.43% (Opus 91.43, Sonnet 91.10, Fable 91.29, Haiku 89.54, Sol 86.45, Astra 87.91), SAGE 53.65% (Opus 45.83, Sonnet 51.77, Fable 48.53, Haiku 45.78, Sol 46.54, Astra 46.37), SRE Bench 44.28% at $30.45/test (Sol 50.76, Astra 56.87, Opus 33.59, Sonnet 30.15, Fable 22.90, Haiku 5.73), LegalBench 88.30% (Fable 5.1 88.51; no other roster row), CUA-bench 4.83% at $193.78/test with the antigravity harness (Opus 14.00 claude-code, Fable 13.17 claude-code, Astra 19.17 codex; rank 7 of 8 on the page), Time Horizon Index: KSP 52.5% at $708.63 (Opus 91.33, Astra 90.50, Fable 63.33). Boards MedCode, MedScribe, SAGE and SRE Bench are dated 2026-10-08, KSP 2026-10-07 and CUA-bench 2026-09-29, so they are older than the 2026-10-12 views. Haiku 5.5 has rows on MedCode, MedScribe, SAGE and SRE Bench.
